info.title: Rosetta Capability Extensions v1 - DESIGN ONLY
info.description: Capability-Driven Layer-1 contracts. Application Registration and application-only approvals are implemented for operator-enrolled humans. All other operations remain design-only and unavailable. See docs/CAPABILITY_RUNTIME_REVIEW_V1.md and docs/APPLICATION_REGISTRATION.md. Existing five-Core APIs remain unchanged.

ApplicationApprovalCreate.description: Implemented application-only decision. resourceId and requesterAppId must equal the stored appId; requesterSubject, digest and revision must match that app. expiresAt must be future UTC Z within ten minutes; approver must be independent.
